test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The marked price of a calculator is Rs. 1600. It is sold at a discount of 28 percent. If the cost price of the calculator is Rs. 700, then what is the value of profit?
solution:
**Given:**

The marked price of the calculator = Rs. 1600

It sold discount of = 28%

The cost price of the calculator = Rs. 700

**Concept:**

Profit = Selling price - Cost price

**Formula used:**

Selling price = Marked price - Discount

**Calculation:**

Let the selling price be S

According to the question

⇒ S = ({1-{28over100}})times 1600={72over100}times 1600=1152

The profit = 1152 - 700 = 452

**∴ The required result will be Rs. 452.**
